comment: PromQL function definition for Kibana. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/functions/
name: label_join
description: Joins the values of the source labels `src_label_1` .. `src_label_N` using `separator` and stores the result in the label `dst_label`. A missing source label contributes an empty string.

params.name: dst_label
params.description: Name of the label to set.

params.name: separator
params.description: String inserted between the source values.

params.name: src_label
params.description: Name of a label to join (repeatable).
